usage: cox setup migrate [-h] [--home HOME] [--dry-run] [--apply] [--hosts] [--finish]
                         [--old-root PATH]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --home HOME      absolute path of the coxswain home to migrate to
  --dry-run        same as the default: print the plans; change nothing
  --apply          execute the plans; without it the command only prints them
  --hosts          with --apply, also run the host steps; use it on the chair's machine
  --finish         own mode, after every host migrated: rewrite queue paths, remove old links
  --old-root PATH  with --finish, the old checkout root when no marker names it
